description: Test health-check-source behavior when API deployment is scaled to zero. Expected: workflow fails at health-check. Actual: ArgoCD selfHeal restored the deployment before the health check could detect the outage.
method: Scale bad-docs-api in bad-docs-api-dev to 0 replicas, close/reopen PR #1 on bad-docs-api-gitops, wait for workflow completion
expected: Workflow should fail at health-check-source (wait-for-source-ready) due to deployment being unavailable
actual: ArgoCD selfHeal (automated.selfHeal=true) restored the deployment to 1 replica before the health check ran. The workflow passed health-check (wait-for-source-ready: Succeeded) but failed at check-0-validate-only as expected for bad-docs-api. The health-check timeout scenario cannot be reliably triggered when selfHeal is enabled.

evidence.observation: selfHeal restores state faster than the EventSource->Sensor->Workflow pipeline can trigger, making it difficult to test health-check timeouts in the current setup
